title: SWITCH FRAMES W1 HEAVY, last 3: Cmd-digit switches among the last 3 of 9 workspaces of 12 beacon panes (a 40-workspace session), filmed at the display rate
why: Lead on STATUS 8158: the warm set holds the visible panes of the last 2 to 3 workspaces, so a switch among them makes no session. The 9-workspace cycle of switch-cmd-digits-heavy rarely returns to the last 3, so it cannot show it.

steps.title: set-up: the window at 70% x 70% of the screen
set-up: 9 workspaces x 12 beacon panes (3 x 4, 4 full redraw at 120 Hz), 31 background workspaces x 3 tabs

steps.name: tiers
steps.title: the app main thread's CPU time per core tier (S/P/E) every 1 ms through the keys (lead on 7776)
warm the last 3 (Cmd-1, 2, 3), then switch among them in a fixed order
the last switch shows a beacon workspace: its beacon runs in the daemon, the app and on screen
